_comment: The licence policy the build gate enforces. NOT legal advice: counsel signs off this file and every 'review' decision. 'proposed' means the engineering team's reading, waiting for that sign-off.

banned.name: AGPL
banned.why: network copyleft: would oblige us to publish our own source (the reason PyMuPDF and MinIO were replaced)

banned.name: SSPL
banned.why: not an open-source licence: service-provider copyleft

banned.name: Non-commercial
banned.why: not allowed in a sold product

banned.name: Research-only
banned.why: not allowed in a sold product

allowed.name: BSD
allowed.pattern: \bbsd\b|3-clause|2-clause|new bsd|simplified bsd|redistribution and use in source and binary forms|numpy developers

nvidia-*.reason: NVIDIA CUDA runtime library pulled in by torch. Proprietary but redistributable under the NVIDIA EULA's redistributable list; on a hosted pod it is the host image's. Counsel to confirm for the installed version.

psycopg.reason: LGPL-3.0, used unmodified as a separate library (pip package, dynamic linking); the licence allows this without opening our code. Counsel to confirm.

psycopg-binary.reason: LGPL-3.0 binary wheel of psycopg, unmodified; same reading as psycopg. Counsel to confirm.
